title: A grid of populations: does PCA draw the map?
description: Thirty-six simulated populations on a 6 by 6 grid, with names A1 to F6. Only neighbours exchange migrants. The plot shows the PC1 and PC2 position of each population, and lines join neighbours. The sliders change the migration rate, who is sampled, and whether the plot is raw or turned onto the true grid.
